stories.title: Tropical Storm Lala floods Midwest, targets Hawaii under hurricane warning
new_facts: Storm is already lashing the Big Island with wind and rain, not merely forecast.
Forecasters warn of up to 25 inches of rain and life-threatening mudslides; off-grid residents urged to evacuate.
Separate Midwest flooding tied to same weather system, with Iowa River rising.
Hawaii declared state of emergency; Lala could be first hurricane to hit Big Island since 1871.

stories.line: Tropical Storm Lala is flooding the Midwest and approaching Hawaii under hurricane warning, with the Big Island facing heavy rain and wind.
